title.narrative: Supporting peace and stabilization in Darfur through dialogue and mediation

description.narrative:
The Action aims to contribute to the peace and stabilisation process in Sudan by supporting peace implementation in Darfur and facilitating efforts at reducing local tensions through dialogue and mediation.

Outcome 1: The peace process in Darfur is progressing in line with the objectives of the protection of civilians

Outcome 2: Inclusive peace and dialogue processes are developed/supported at the local level (West Darfur)

Outcome 3: Local populations¿ needs and constraints are better included in the peace and stabilisation process at the State and regional level in Darfur
